arStrings.szText: Belial's story is complete. Continue targeting {c_highlight}Bosses{/c} and collecting {icon:Item_BossPower_Currency, 2.3} {c_highlight}Spectral Ash{/c} to master {icon:Inventory_Tab_Icon_Boss_Selected, 2.} {c_highlight}Boss Powers{/c}.

Fight powerful {icon:Marker_Dungeon_BossLair,1.8} {c_highlight}Lair Bosses{/c} across Sanctuary for immense rewards and a chance at build-defining {c:FFfa950f}Ancestral{/c} and {c:FFd5b3e6}Mythic Unique{/c} Items.
Various activities yield the keys required to open the Lair Boss's {c_highlight}Hoard{/c}, which contains keys needed to open a more powerful Lair Boss's Hoard.
Each Lair Boss's Hoard has a high chance at earning specific Unique Items. Higher-powered Lair Boss Hoards have a greater chance at {c:FFd5b3e6}Mythic Unique{/c} Items.

{icon:Marker_ApparitionIncursionBelial, 2.3} {c_highlight}Belial{/c} waits to ambush after opening any Lair Boss's Hoard. Defeat him to earn the keys to open his Supreme Forms Hoard within {icon:Marker_Dungeon_BossLair,1.8}{c_highlight}Palace of the Deceiver{/c}.
